description: Reads the song DNA from a MusicMind report the person made on zeltorlabs.com and shared: key and Camelot code with the keys that mix with it, BPM, genre mix, section structure with energy, and production DNA (energy profile, mood, arrangement density, compression, biggest moments). Takes the share link (https://zeltorlabs.com/report/r/<code>) or its code. Use the key and BPM with check_mix to compare it with another song. If the person has no report yet, they can make one free at https://zeltorlabs.com/analyze (the audio is analyzed in their browser).

link.description: The report share link, e.g. https://zeltorlabs.com/report/r/abc123def456, or its code.

name: song_report
title: Read a shared Zeltor song report (song DNA)
